'''Dreadclaw''' is a [[Water]] type [[Guardian]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Clawzor]] at 18 stars, and evolves into [[Cribking]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Once a plain gray crab, Dreadclaw's vivid colors actually came from consumed pollutants. Every so often, those bright claws make an appearance, along with a grip strong enough to prove a point. After all, in the wild, beauty needs strength to back it up."

Dreadclaw is a red rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A purple crab with a white underside and red eyelids. Its irises are blue and its pupils are black. One of its claws is significantly larger than its body, similar to a [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fiddler_crab fiddler crab]. The tips of its claws and legs are red, and it has red spikes on its head. It's also wearing a red belt with a yellow-orange, triangular buckle.

Dreadclaw's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces red with yellow.

== Evolution Trial ==
Dreadclaw's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 36 stars. To evolve it into [[Cribking]] you need to complete the following three tasks:

* Feed this Tatari to B quality.
* Play Fishing Contest (use x6000 fishing rods) or Zobo Shooter (use x1,200,000 bullet coints).
* Obtain 50 more Tatari Wishboxes.

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "Dreadclaw can bench 200kg, but cant even squat 20kg. Never skip leg day!"
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "Generating water pressure like a high-powered jet, Dreadclaw rarely accepts challenges, deeming no opponents fit."
